scope: local synthetic contrasts and hypothetical arithmetic sensitivity, not human evaluation

contamination_levels: No contamination is stipulated in this fictional scenario.
Dry dust contamination is stipulated in this fictional scenario.
Food residue contamination is stipulated in this fictional scenario.
contrast.selection: full Cartesian product, no adaptive search or early stopping
contrast.fixed_text_caveat: All other fields, including description and process naming PET and clean trim, remain byte-equivalent values. Non-PET and dirty variants intentionally contain stale narrative context; they are structured-field contrasts, not newly coherent field cases.
contrast.hypothesis: Without route reviews all strict route eligibility remains unknown. Public fallback can introduce only mechanical-recycling. Priority is fixed mechanical-recycling, reuse, other-recovery, disposal. State changes or recommendation withdrawal do not constitute a switch to another first route.

sensitivity.price_rule: selected_material.price = original selected_material.price * multiplier; published price.PET / price.PE references remain unchanged
sensitivity.allocation_meaning: Fraction allocated to WARM recycling after sorting; not an independently measured physical substitution ratio and not an extra embedded process yield.
sensitivity.derived_data_contract: Validate original fixture once with existing loader. Pass a one-case derived data object to the real arithmetic engine with separate derived fixture/provenance hashes. Derived scenarios are explicitly not validator-approved fixtures and not the fixed verified catalog.
sensitivity.incineration_cost: f_inc stays null in every scenario
sensitivity.independent_oracle: BigInt rational arithmetic from decimal input strings, independently expanded formulas; compare every cost component, revenue, cost, carbon, baseline deltas, per-tonne value and display rounding.
sensitivity.ranking: Separate ascending cost and carbon orders; exclude null from numeric ordering. Pareto only among routes with both metrics. Unknown incineration cost prevents a complete three-route cost/Pareto conclusion.
unchanged_assumptions: Fictional masses PET 0.024 t and HDPE 0.018 t; not measured.
US WARM default net lifecycle coefficients hypothetically map to Korean synthetic manufacturing scrap; residue same polymer.
HDPE price is a generic PE proxy, not a verified HDPE or batch quote.
Compressed mixed-colour reference sale form and sorting preparation assumed; tax and logistics unverified.
Wonju fee transfer, transport distances/rate, collection/sorting costs and zero recycling fee remain hypothetical.
WARM includes embedded transport; do not add a separate carbon transport term or physical substitution parameter.
Arithmetic rankings are distinct from fixed domain recommendation review priority and establish no legal or facility eligibility.

restrictions.original_data: read-only; hash source, public inputs, registry and upstream files before/after
restrictions.temporary_root: comparison/.work created exclusively by this script and removed in finally
restrictions.tests: Only existing relevant tests if an unresolved correctness question requires them; independent numeric oracle is the primary check.
